# SmarkForm

> SmarkForm is a lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript library for building structured HTML forms with markup-driven fields, nested lists and JSON import/export.

SmarkForm enhances ordinary HTML using `data-smark` attributes. Forms export as objects, lists as arrays, and fields stay synchronized with the DOM.

- [Core Concepts](https://smarkform.bitifet.net/getting_started/core_concepts): Markup syntax, component trees and value types.
- [Component Types](https://smarkform.bitifet.net/getting_started/core_component_types): Built-in field and component types.
- [Showcase](https://smarkform.bitifet.net/about/showcase): Interactive examples.
- [Examples](https://smarkform.bitifet.net/resources/examples): Downloadable, ready-to-run forms.
- [Developer Cheatsheet](https://smarkform.bitifet.net/resources/cheatsheet): Compact API reference.
- [FAQ](https://smarkform.bitifet.net/about/faq): Common implementation questions.
